response.sql: SELECT trans.operation, AVG(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -trans.amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) as large_transaction_count FROM trans WHERE trans.amount >= 2400 GROUP BY trans.operation ORDER BY trans.operation

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff condition uses strictly greater-than (>) rather than greater-than-or-equal-to (>=), treating 2400 as the lower boundary such that only transactions above 2400 are large, excluding exactly 2400
